title: Welcome to the Blog
excerpt: This is the first post on the blog — a placeholder showing how new posts get added. Replace this with your own writing any time.
content:
This is the first post on the blog.

To add a new post, open data/posts.json and add a new object to the array at the top, with a unique "slug", a "title", a "date", a short "excerpt" for the card preview, and the full "content" of the post. Paragraphs in "content" are separated by a blank line, just like this file.

No rebuild step is needed — the page reads this file directly, so saving the JSON and redeploying is all it takes.
